bill.title: Honoring the unbreakable spirit, bravery, and legacy of women veterans and supporting recognition of "Women Veterans Recognition Day".
bill.latestActionText: Referred to the House Committee on Veterans' Affairs.
bill.officialSummary: This resolution expresses support for the designation of Women Veterans Recognition Day and recognizes the contributions, sacrifices, and achievements of women veterans.

plain.whatItDoes: This resolution would express support for the designation of Women Veterans Recognition Day and recognize the contributions, sacrifices, and achievements of women veterans.
plain.whoItTouches: People in the military, and their families.
plain.everydayEffect: If it passed, the change would show up in service, and what the military buys. Nothing has changed yet. This kind of resolution does not become law, even if it passes.
plain.source: Reworded from the official summary. Staff at the Congressional Research Service wrote that summary. It is public domain, and the full text of it is further down this page.

disclaimer: This tool places two public records next to each other: who donated to a member of Congress, and what that member legislated on. Any overlap you see is a correlation, not causation. It is not evidence of a quid pro quo, of influence, or of wrongdoing. Legislators routinely receive support from industries in their district for the same reason they legislate on them: those industries are there.
